name: the Dungeons
title: 🕯️ The Dungeons
blurb: Cold stone corridors under the castle that used to hold something worse than students in detention. Not everything down here left when the doors were unlocked.

areas.at: among the old cells, doors long since rusted open
at a forgotten shrine cut into the wall
at the edge of a collapsed passage
in an old storeroom, shelves long empty
over a drainage grate that hums faintly
on the stairwell, three steps below where the torches stop
in front of an iron door, sealed and cold

atmospheres.text: The air is cold enough to see your own breath.
Water drips somewhere close, on an unhurried, uneven rhythm.
Your torchlight doesn't seem to reach quite as far as it should.
Something scrapes stone, once, somewhere behind you.
It's utterly silent down here - the kind of silence that has weight.
The old iron sconces still hold a little unnatural light.
A draft moves through with no obvious source, carrying the smell of damp stone.
Your footsteps echo longer than they should, like someone else's are mixed in.

creatures.a: a knot of dungeon rats, unbothered by your light
an old suit of armor that creaks when nothing moves it
a damp little will-o'-the-wisp, drifting between the bars
something chained, somewhere out of sight, that just moans once
a shadow moving under the iron door, though nothing should be behind it

objects.a: a set of broken manacles, still bolted to the wall
a cracked funerary urn, long since emptied
a rusted iron ring set into the floor
an alchemy bench, stained with things you'd rather not identify
deep scratch marks on the inside of a cell door

discoveries.text: a name carved into the stone, over and over, in a hand that got shakier each time
a tally of days scratched into the wall that stopped mid-count
a patch of pale fungus growing in a perfect ring on the floor
a coin purse, ancient and empty except for a single strange coin
a door that's warm to the touch, for no reason you can find
a single unlit candle, standing upright in a puddle that shouldn't be there
a rusted key, half-buried, that doesn't fit any lock nearby

outcomes.text: The cold here doesn't feel quite as sharp as it did when you arrived.
Your torch burns a little steadier than it should, this deep down.
Nothing follows you back up the stairs. This time.
The dark parts around you, just slightly, like it's letting you through.
You get the distinct feeling something is counting your steps.
A draft pushes past you, moving the wrong way for the corridor's shape.
The torches gutter as you pass, one after another, like something's following the flame.
You leave faster than you meant to. Something down here noticed you.
The silence presses in, a little heavier than before.
Something metal settles, once, in the dark behind you.

forage_lines: You dig through old debris {loc} and come away with {item}.
forage_empty: You search {loc} and find nothing but old dust and colder air.
{Loc}, whatever was here has long since rotted away.
You come away from {loc} empty-handed, glad to be leaving.

feed_good: {The} takes it and, strangely, seems to calm down.
feed_meh: {The} doesn't want it, or can't take it. It's hard to tell down here.
follow_good: You follow {the} down a passage you didn't know existed, and it leads somewhere worth finding.
{The} leads you through the dark and then, quite suddenly, isn't there anymore.
follow_lost: You follow {the} in circles for a while before giving up and finding your own way back.
steal_good: You take it quickly and quietly. Nothing reacts. That's not exactly comforting.
steal_caught: Something reacts immediately, and not kindly. You leave with nothing and a fright.
leave: You leave {the} well alone and find your way back to the light.
Whatever it was, you decide it's not worth disturbing. You move on.
tend: You clear the fungus ring gently and leave it undisturbed but tidier.
uproot: You tear it up. The stone underneath is unpleasantly warm.

offer_lines.full: Whatever's down here has had enough offerings for one day. Your gift sits there, untouched.
warm: The offering vanishes from where you set it down, quick and quiet.
Something down here seems, if only slightly, less hostile.
cold: Your offering just sits there in the dark. Nothing comes for it.
The dark takes it without any sign it noticed.

phrases: i strain against the old chains
secrets.response: 🐺 The chain holds, then doesn't. It was never locked - just old enough to look like it was.

phrases: i stand silent at the shrine
i watch over the forgotten shrine
secrets.response: 🦌 You stand with it a while and say nothing. Nothing answers. But the cold in the room eases, just slightly, just for you.

phrases: i light a candle at the shrine
secrets.response: 🐘 You cup a hand around the last stub of candle and it catches, though you brought no match. Whoever this shrine was for, they're grateful.

phrases: i study the iron door's lock
i map the iron door's mechanism
secrets.response: 🔭 You trace the mechanism with a fingertip until it makes sense. It's not locked. It was just never meant to open outward.

phrases: i test a theory on the alchemy table
i run an experiment in the alchemy room
secrets.response: 🌕 You change one variable - just one. The residue in the beaker changes colour to match your own house scarf. You did not expect that.

phrases: i ask the dungeons for a gift
what would you give me down here
secrets.response: 🪙 Something rolls out from under the storeroom door and stops, deliberately, at your feet.
⛓️ You say it into the dark of the long corridor. Somewhere, a chain that's been dragging stops dragging.

phrases: i count the doors down here
secrets.response: 🍀 You count twelve. You count again and get eleven. You decide not to count a third time.

phrases: i listen at the drainage grate at night
i listen at the grate after dark
secrets.response: 🩶 Something below the grate is breathing in a rhythm that isn't yours. You back away slowly and don't look down again.
